result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: Vendor defends and indemnifies Customer and its Affiliates against third-party IP, legal-compliance, Vendor-caused data-breach, gross-negligence, and wilful-misconduct claims; Customer’s indemnity is narrowly limited to Customer-provided content and legal violations; and standard notice, control, cooperation, and settlement procedures are included. The customary IP exclusions and procure/modify/replace/refund remedies are appropriately tailored and also resolve the existing Section 20.5 cross-references. No unrelated commercial terms are substantively altered, and the drafting is clear and professional.
